$comment: Observation checkpoints for the Marjorie Overhaul (epic #4180). plan-recheck-marjorie.yml runs daily; the routine handles every entry whose due <= today and status == pending, then flips status to reported via PR. Statuses: pending | reported | skipped. The M1 session sets MR1/MR2 dates when M1 merges (due is null until then, and a null due is never due).

checkpoints.title: Comms hold under real schedules (+7d after M1)
checks: routine-marjorie-brief.yml: every scheduled run since M1 merged succeeded and each posted one message to #longlive-marjorie (run log shows the Discord POST 2xx)
No workflow other than production-backup.yml invoked scripts/watchdog/send-mail.py in the window (search run logs), and the fallback step never fired unless a Discord call returned non-2xx
watchdog.yml opened or closed at least one alert in the window and the same alert appeared in #longlive-marjorie (run log)
marjorie-inbox.yml no longer exists on main
The brief's waiting-on-you section lists exactly the open HUMAN-ACTIONS.md numbers on the day it ran (compare one brief to the file at that SHA)

M4 loop, first real cycle (2026-09-14): Tree's weekly-plan brief listed open marjorie-filed #4252 under 'From Marjorie' and Tree closed it with a comment citing its plan PR; Marjorie's 09-14 brief issue Tree section has 'From Tree:' and 'For Tree:' lines; any ask either bot made that week became a tree-filed / marjorie-filed issue with no duplicate (search each label for two issues sharing one loop-ask key)

checkpoints.title: Marjorie acted on real events (+21d after M1)
checks: routine-marjorie-ops.yml resolved at least one real watchdog-alert issue: the issue shows Marjorie's comment, a dispatch or a human action, and a close
If the FB export alert fired, a HUMAN-ACTIONS.md item with literal steps was filed by the routine via PR and appeared as a card (HUMAN-ACTIONS.md history)
routine-marjorie-triage.yml handled at least one intake or feedback issue: either a build-desk issue with acceptance criteria or an in-channel founder question with a recommendation
Nothing was auto-closed by triage without a founder or a merged fix
If M4 merged: one Monday cycle produced an issue from a Tree ask and an issue from a Marjorie ask, both numbered in the next brief

M5 chat: at least one real founder message answered in-thread with ✅ in each of #longlive-marjorie and #longlive-tree since M5 merged (count the brief issues' `💬 chat:` turn-log comments and cite the run URLs); every [chat failed] notice has one ❌ and no second notice for the same message

M7 doorbell: rang for at least one real founder message in each of #longlive-marjorie and #longlive-tree — the message carries 👀 from Long Live Doorbell and its chat run's triggering actor is the doorbell key's owner (event workflow_dispatch); cite the run URLs and each message-to-✅ time from the run's `replied in <n>s` line

checkpoints.title: Renew the doorbell's GitHub key a month before it expires (2027-09-13)
checks: longlive-doorbell-dispatch (fine-grained, swift2 only, Actions: Read and write) expires 2027-09-13. If it has not been renewed, file a HUMAN-ACTIONS.md item (v2) to create its replacement with the same scope, replace DOORBELL_GITHUB_TOKEN in /etc/longlive-doorbell.env on the Hermes VM host, and run sudo systemctl restart longlive-doorbell (docs/ops/doorbell.md, Keys)
After the renewal, confirm a clock-started run of bot-chat-poll.yml shows event workflow_dispatch by the key's owner within the last hour
